records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures as he speaks to a seated listener beside a deep blue pool, while a brook cascades over rocks into the water; trees, hills, and a distant village fill the sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by the verse's comparison of a man's words to deep waters and wisdom's wellspring to a flowing brook.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone town gate, a richly dressed man offers a pouch to a seated judge beside a tilted balance, while a plainly dressed man waits with an outstretched hand.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative court scene illustrates the warning against favoring the wicked and denying justice to the righteous in Proverbs 18:5.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village marketplace, a man gestures and shouts at another man who raises a fist. An older man holds up his hands between them as worried bystanders look on.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts contentious speech leading toward the blows described in Proverbs 18:6.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a startled man stumbles as a golden cord emerging from his mouth loops around his ankle, while four nearby villagers recoil in concern.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of the fool whose mouth brings destruction and whose lips become a snare to his own life in Proverbs 18:7.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man leans in to whisper to a seated man, who holds a sweet morsel near his mouth and rests his other hand on his abdomen. A bowl of sweets sits on the table between them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects a talebearer's enticing words with the tasty morsels that, in Proverbs 18:8, go down into the inmost body.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated worker rests beside unused tools and an unfinished stone wall while another man breaks a section of the wall with a hammer; fallen stones lie between them, with a sunlit village and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Proverbs 18:9's comparison between slackness in work and destruction.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit palace courtyard, a richly dressed man reclines among cushions and a lavish feast, holding grapes and a cup. Nearby, a plainly dressed man gestures toward seated, richly dressed princes, who look up at him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 19:10, which contrasts luxury for a fool with a servant ruling over princes.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a seated man reaches out gently to a distressed kneeling person beside a broken earthenware jar and spilled water.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the patient restraint and overlooking of an offense described in Proverbs 19:11.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king seated on a palace terrace extends a hand toward a kneeling visitor. A lion roars from a rocky rise beyond the garden, while dew glistens on foreground grass in the dawn light.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the verse's comparison of a king's wrath to a lion's roar and his favor to dew on grass.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a rustic home, a weary seated father rests his head in his hand beside spilled grain and broken pottery. A downcast young man stands nearby as a woman speaks to the father; drops from the roof fall into a bowl.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the foolish son's ruin for his father and the comparison of a wife's contentions to continual dripping in Proverbs 19:13.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman holding wheat gestures toward stored grain while a man listens; an older man stands beside an open chest of valuables near the house.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 19:14, suggesting a father's material inheritance and the gift of a prudent wife from Yahweh.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sleeps beneath a tree beside a dry, overgrown garden, with an empty earthenware bowl in the foreground and a village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of deep sleep and an empty bowl suggests the proverb's link between laziness, sleep, and hunger.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler carries a closed scroll along a sunlit stone path while another traveler heads toward a crumbling cliff; olive trees, flowers, hills, and a village fill the landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the person who keeps the commandment and preserves his life with the danger faced by one careless of his ways in Proverbs 19:16.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A villager kneels beside an elderly traveler on a sunlit stone path, sharing a loaf of bread and holding a water jug. Olive trees, fields, and a village lie behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of kindness to a poor traveler, reflecting Proverbs 19:17's promise that the Lord regards and repays generosity to the poor.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father sits beside his young son in a sunlit stone village, resting a hand on his shoulder and gesturing toward a path as the boy looks up at him; a green sapling grows nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a father guiding his son with hope and restraint, reflecting Proverbs 19:18.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village pottery market, a concerned man pulls back an angry man with clenched fists while a distressed merchant sits beside shattered clay pots; more intact pots stand nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 19:19: anger brings consequences, and rescuing an angry person can become a repeated task.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village marketplace, a traveler in worn clothing holds out a small purse to a seated merchant. Behind them, a man in red gestures while speaking to another man at a stall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative marketplace scene reflects the proverb’s contrast between a poor person walking in integrity and a fool whose speech is perverse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures as he speaks to a younger man seated beside him beneath an olive tree. A winding path leads past trees and stone buildings toward sunlit hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes listening to counsel and receiving instruction, with the distant path suggesting wisdom in later days.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful man in a cream robe stands beside a large olive tree, looking over branching paths that wind through a sunlit valley toward distant villages and hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the many plans in a person's heart and the enduring counsel of Yahweh in Proverbs 19:21.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A plainly dressed man shares a loaf of bread with a seated traveler on a sunlit village street, while a richly dressed merchant holds an open pouch nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 19:22's value of kindness and its contrast between a poor person and a liar.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits with his hands joined and head bowed outside a stone home at sunset. Bread, fruit and a lit oil lamp rest beside him, a dog sleeps at his feet, and a fig tree and flowering garden overlook distant hills and rain clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of reverence, provision and peaceful rest reflecting Proverbs 19:23.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A reclining man in a sunlit stone courtyard rests his head on one hand while the other lies in a bowl of food on a low table. Bread, fruit, pottery, patterned cushions, and vines surround him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 19:24, where a lazy man puts his hand in a bowl but does not bring it back to his mouth.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an elder speaks earnestly to a seated man who listens thoughtfully. Behind them, a young onlooker watches warily as a man raises a stick toward another man recoiling.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 19:25: a simple observer becomes wary at a scoffer's chastening, while a person of understanding listens to correction.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an angry man clutches a chest and other belongings while pointing toward the open gate. An elderly man recoils beside him, and an elderly woman walks away through the gate, looking back.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 19:26, in which a son mistreats his father, drives away his mother, and brings shame and reproach.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father gestures toward a young man turning away from him onto a rocky, overgrown hillside path; a clear road, village, lake and mountains lie behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a son turning away from instruction and straying, inspired by Proverbs 19:27.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a stone town gate, a smiling man gestures dismissively toward seated elders while an anxious man watches and another man bites a dark fruit.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative town-gate hearing depicts a witness scorning justice; the fruit is a visual metaphor for the wicked devouring iniquity.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a stern seated judge points toward a defiant man standing with his back partly turned. An attendant nearby holds a lowered rod.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative court scene evokes the judgments prepared for scoffers and the blows for the backs of fools in Proverbs 19:29.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A startled traveler in a cream tunic and red-brown cloak stumbles on a rocky hillside path, with a smoother path winding behind him through a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the verse’s warning about acting without knowledge and hastening with one’s feet.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A frustrated traveler among thorny branches on a rocky hillside path raises one hand toward the sky; a clear road winds through the valley below.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 19:3: a person’s foolishness twists his way while his heart frets against Yahweh.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village marketplace, four smiling companions gather around a richly dressed man holding a purse. Nearby, a poor man in worn clothing reaches toward a man who turns away with a raised hand.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Proverbs 19:4: wealth brings many friends, while the poor are separated from a friend.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man gestures before three seated elders at a stone town gate while another man watches; a sunlit town and hills appear beyond the open gateway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a witness facing the elders evokes the proverb’s warning that a false witness and speaker of lies will not escape accountability.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated nobleman in purple offers a small red gift pouch as smiling townspeople gather around him in a sunlit stone courtyard; a basket of wrapped gifts rests on his lap.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of people seeking a nobleman's favor and gathering around a giver of gifts, reflecting Proverbs 19:6.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in worn, patched clothing sits on a stone wall and reaches toward four figures walking away along a sunlit village path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 19:7: a poor man appeals as others turn away and leave him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older teacher speaks to a young learner who tends a fruiting fig tree beside a spring in a sunlit hillside garden.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative garden scene suggests receiving and keeping wisdom and understanding, and finding good, as in Proverbs 19:8.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man gestures before three seated elders at a stone town gate, with a spear-bearing guard behind him and a withered tree beside a distant path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents Proverbs 19:9’s warning that a false witness will not go unpunished and one who speaks lies will perish.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling young man sits beneath an olive tree with one hand over his heart, where golden light forms a flowering branch. Flowers and a stream fill the garden, with hills and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 2:10: wisdom enters the heart, and knowledge is pleasant to the soul.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit hillside, two robed women guide a young traveler beside a broken path above a rocky ravine. One raises a hand to stop him while the other points toward a stone-lined path winding among olive trees.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative allegory of Proverbs 2:11, showing discretion and understanding as guides who protect a traveler from danger.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young traveler raises a hand toward a bearded man beckoning from a rocky, thorn-covered path, while an older woman points toward a sunlit path among olive trees.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Proverbs 2:12: wise guidance turns a traveler away from an evil path and a man speaking perverse things.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Four robed travelers turn from a sunlit road onto a rocky path leading into a dark grove, with a village and hills across the bright valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative visual metaphor for Proverbs 2:13, showing people leaving the paths of uprightness to walk in the ways of darkness.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling merchant touches a balance scale's pan as a grinning companion watches; across the stall, a worried customer gestures amid sacks of grain in a sunlit market.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative marketplace scene illustrates Proverbs 2:14's description of people rejoicing in wrongdoing and delighting in the perversity of the wicked.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two robed travelers exchange wary glances on a rocky hillside; one points toward winding, branching dirt paths, with a village and blue mountains in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene representing Proverbs 2:15's crooked ways and devious paths.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman reaches from a stone doorway toward a man in robes, who raises one hand and walks away along a sunlit path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 2:16: the man turns away from the woman's flattering invitation, suggesting deliverance from her words.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a rust-red dress and cream shawl walks away along a sunlit stone path as a man reaches toward her from a stone house. An unlit clay lamp and a braided cord rest on the doorstep, with olive trees, a distant village, and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the woman leaving the companion of her youth; the neglected lamp and cord suggest her forgotten covenant with God.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman stands in the doorway of a stone house on a sunny hillside. Winding paths descend through rocky ground toward a shadowed tomb, where faint figures stand in mist.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 2:18: paths descending from her house toward a tomb and shadowy figures evoke its warning about death and the dead.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three robed travelers walk toward a woman standing in the doorway of a shadowed stone house. Across a deep rocky ravine, a sunlit path winds through green trees toward a distant village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of the warning in Proverbs 2:19 that those who go to her do not return or regain the paths of life; the ravine and sunlit path are visual metaphors.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father sits beneath an olive tree in a sunlit stone courtyard, speaking with open hands to his young son, who listens with one hand over his heart. Earthenware jars, leafy plants, and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a son receiving his father's words and treasuring his commands within, as in Proverbs 2:1.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young traveler helps an older man over rocks while three other travelers follow a winding path toward a sunlit village among olive trees and hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects a shared path and an act of care with Proverbs 2:20's call to walk in the way of goodness and keep the paths of righteousness.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunny garden, a family plants and waters a young olive tree beside a stone house. Two elders sit nearby; tomatoes, olive groves, and a distant village fill the surrounding hillside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene of a family tending their home and land evokes the upright dwelling in the land and the blameless remaining there. It is not a historical reconstruction.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An uprooted thorny bush, its exposed roots trailing soil, is carried over a field beside a broken thorn branch. Olive trees, stone walls, and a distant village fill a sunlit valley beneath blue hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative visual metaphor for Proverbs 2:22: the severed branch and uprooted bush reflect the wicked being cut off and the unfaithful being uprooted from the land.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard beneath an olive tree, a young listener cups one hand behind an ear and rests the other on the chest while an older man speaks with an open-handed gesture. Pottery, fields, a village, and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking Proverbs 2:2's call to incline the ear to wisdom and apply the heart to understanding.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young person in a cream tunic, rust-colored wrap, and sandals stands among rocks and olive trees, cupping one hand to their mouth and raising the other toward a sunrise over a valley and village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the verse's call to cry out for discernment and lift one's voice for understanding.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young seeker kneels on a sunlit rocky hillside, using a hand spade beside a partly unearthed clay jar containing silver pieces. Trees, distant hills, and a small village appear in the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 2:4's comparison of seeking wisdom with searching for silver and hidden treasure.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young person kneels beneath an olive tree with a hand over their heart, looking toward the sunrise. Beside them, a rolled parchment rests in a tipped clay jar among rocks and wildflowers, while a path winds toward a hillside village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 2:5: the seeker's reverent gaze and discovered scroll suggest understanding the fear of Yahweh and finding the knowledge of God.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young learner in ancient clothing sits beneath an olive tree with open hands, looking up as a stream of golden light descends from the clouds. A blank scroll rests among rocks and wildflowers, with hills and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene portraying wisdom as a gift from Yahweh; the light suggests knowledge and understanding coming from His mouth, as in Proverbs 2:6.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man with a walking stick and a younger traveler walk along a rocky hillside path beneath a glowing golden dome as stones fall nearby. A small stone storehouse beside them contains clay jars and a lit oil lamp.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the upright walking under God's protection and uses the stored lamp to suggest the sound wisdom kept for them in Proverbs 2:7.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed traveler carries a staff along a stone-lined path above a ravine. Beside an olive tree, an elder weighs grain on a balance as two neighbors watch; sunlight falls over the winding paths and distant village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 2:8: the protected path and the weighing of grain suggest God guarding the paths of justice and preserving the way of His faithful one.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit village path, a young traveler watches an elder weigh grain on a balance between two men; nearby, a man helps another rise, with olive trees, village houses, and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses attentive learning, fair dealing, and helping another along a path to evoke Proverbs 2:9's understanding of righteousness, justice, equity, and every good path.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, a concerned customer watches a merchant beside a hanging balance with unequal weights; two different-sized measures filled with grain sit on the counter.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative marketplace scene illustrating Proverbs 20:10's condemnation of differing weights and measures.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village market, a smiling boy offers an open pouch of coins to a surprised older seller, who reaches toward it across a fruit stall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the verse’s thought that a child is known by his deeds and whether his conduct is pure and right.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A child with a visible ear and wide eyes watches an open-beaked bird on a branch, while a smiling woman sits beside the child in a sunlit garden of flowers and stone walls.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of seeing and listening, recalling Proverbs 20:12's teaching that Yahweh made both the seeing eye and the hearing ear.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An awake man sits at a wooden table eating bread beside a sleeping place, while sunrise lights a field and farming tools beyond an open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts open eyes and bread in Proverbs 20:13, alongside the call to wakefulness.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling buyer carries a richly patterned cloth away from a marketplace stall, gesturing as he speaks to a companion while the seller watches from behind the textiles.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the buyer boasting after leaving, reflecting Proverbs 20:14 and its contrast with his disparagement during the purchase.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man speaks with open hands to an attentive child in a sunlit stone courtyard, beside an open chest filled with gold vessels and red jewels.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting gold and many rubies with the precious value of lips of knowledge in Proverbs 20:15.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a worried man hands a patterned brown cloak across a wooden table to a seated man. Two travelers carrying bundles stand near an open gate behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a garment being received as a pledge, reflecting Proverbs 20:16 and its mention of surety for strangers.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in a sunlit village courtyard holds torn bread near his mouth and looks with concern at pebbles and crumbs in his open palm. A loaf, fruit, and a plate with more pebbles sit on the table.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes the proverb's contrast between the sweetness of bread gained by deceit and the gravel that fills the mouth afterward.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A commander listens to advisers gathered around a terrain model marked with stones, with shields, spears and an encampment nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of military planning through counsel reflects Proverbs 20:18.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a man whispers to a seated neighbor while a third man walks away with one hand raised.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 20:19's warning about a talebearer who reveals secrets and the counsel to avoid associating with a flatterer.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a man holding a cup staggers beside a stone path while a man and woman argue near a table with spilled wine and a tipped clay jug. Grapevines shade the courtyard and the path leads toward distant houses.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing the warning of Proverbs 20:1: wine and strong drink can lead to strife and lead a person away from wisdom.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An angry young man gestures toward an older man and woman seated together in a dim ancient home. A clay oil lamp on the table has gone out, and smoke rises from its wick.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Proverbs 20:20’s warning about cursing a father or mother and a lamp going out in darkness.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man kneels beside an open chest, eagerly gathering coins in a sunlit stone courtyard. Drying grapevines hang behind him, and a broken clay jar spills grain onto the ground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of an inheritance gained greedily or hastily at the beginning, whose end is not blessed.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits beneath an olive tree beside a stone wall, his hand relaxed near a stone on the ground, while another man walks away along a village road toward sunlit hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests restraint from repaying evil and waiting for Yahweh's deliverance, as encouraged in Proverbs 20:22.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, a merchant places a stone on one pan of a tilted balance while holding a different stone at his side; grain fills the other pan, and a concerned customer watches.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative marketplace scene illustrating Proverbs 20:23's warning about differing weights and dishonest scales.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed traveler with a staff pauses on a rocky path marked by footprints. The path climbs past flowers and olive trees toward a sunlit bend, with a village and hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the steps that belong to Yahweh and the limits of a person’s understanding of his own way.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful man stands beside a decorated clay vessel on a stone table in a sunlit village courtyard, with a loose rope loop on the ground near his feet.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the snare of dedicating something rashly and reconsidering after making vows, as described in Proverbs 20:25.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king in red robes winnows golden grain from a basket on a threshing floor. Oxen stand beside a large threshing wheel, and three figures walk away beyond a low stone wall, with fields and hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 20:26 through a wise king separating grain and chaff, a threshing wheel, and departing figures.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A contemplative man in a linen robe sits in a stone room holding a glowing clay oil lamp near his chest; arched chambers recede into the shadows behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking Proverbs 20:27, where a person’s spirit is Yahweh’s lamp, searching the inner depths.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king leans from a richly decorated throne to reach the hand of a kneeling petitioner, while an adviser watches in a sunlit palace.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a merciful king evokes Proverbs 20:28, where mercy and truth preserve the king and lovingkindness upholds his throne.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man carries a large bundle of firewood on his shoulder as he walks beside a smiling elder with silver-gray hair and beard in a sunlit stone village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the strength of young men and the splendor of gray hair in old age in Proverbs 20:29.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit palace courtyard, an angry crowned king points toward a frightened man recoiling on the ground, while a lion roars beside the king's stone seat.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 20:2's comparison of the fear of a king to a lion's roar and its warning about provoking the king.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful metalworker strikes a dark-encrusted bronze bowl with a hammer, knocking flakes onto his workbench and revealing its bright golden interior in a sunlit stone workshop.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative image of blows removing darkness from a vessel evokes the verse’s account of painful blows cleansing evil and reaching the inner depths of the heart.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a man walks away with open hands while another man behind him gestures angrily. Olive branches, pottery, vines, and distant buildings frame the scene.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 20:3: it is honorable to stop strife, while a fool can start a quarrel.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holds out an empty bowl in a barren field beside a wooden plow, while people harvest golden grain beyond a stone wall and rain falls in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 20:4, showing a man seeking food at harvest after not plowing because of winter.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man speaks with a hand over his chest while another listens and lifts a bucket of water from a stone well in a sunlit village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the verse's comparison of counsel in the heart to deep water, drawn out by a person of understanding.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village square, a man helps an elderly neighbor gather spilled grain while a woman watches thoughtfully; behind them, several men gesture toward themselves as they talk.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasts self-praise with a quiet act of help, reflecting the verse's question about finding a faithful person.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit village path, a man offers a small pouch to a traveler while two smiling children follow behind him; trees, stone buildings and distant hills fill the landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 20:7: an honest act suggests the righteous man walking in integrity, while his children follow in a joyful setting.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king sits on a raised throne in a sunlit stone court, watching dark wisps scatter into the sky. Courtiers stand nearby, with hills and a town in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the king on the throne of judgment scattering evil with his eyes in Proverbs 20:8.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful man sits in a sunlit stone courtyard with one hand over his heart, looking at his reflection in a broad clay basin. A jug and folded cloth rest nearby, with olive branches and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 20:9's question about who can claim a clean heart and purity from sin.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a stern man clutches a basket of grain and looks back at another man reaching toward him in distress.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the wicked person’s desire for evil and lack of favor toward his neighbor in Proverbs 21:10.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient village courtyard, an elder points toward a man gathering fruit from an overturned basket as a young onlooker watches. Nearby, one seated man gestures toward a plant while another listens.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the simple person learning from a scoffer’s punishment and the wise person receiving knowledge through instruction.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two richly dressed men stumble on a rocky slope beside a basket spilling gold as the stone house behind them collapses under a shaft of sunlight.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 21:12, where the righteous God considers the house of the wicked and overthrows the wicked for their wickedness.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A poor man in worn clothing sits beside a stone doorway and reaches toward a richly dressed passerby, who turns away with one hand at his ear on a sunlit village street.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the cry of the poor being ignored in Proverbs 21:13; the verse warns that the person who shuts his ear will also cry out and not be heard.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man discreetly offers a small cloth pouch to a guarded, bearded man in a blue robe beside a wooden door.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a discreet gift offered amid tension, reflecting the proverb’s words about a secret gift pacifying anger and a concealed bribe addressing strong wrath.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, an elder hands a basket of grain to a smiling woman as another man looks on joyfully. Two distressed men recoil beside an overturned market stall, scattered grain, coins, weights, and scales.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene connects the joy of doing justice with the ruin of wrongdoing in Proverbs 21:15.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A weary man in ancient-style robes sits among rocky, unmarked tombs, looking toward a sunlit path through a golden landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a man resting among tombs after leaving the path evokes the proverb's warning about wandering from the way of understanding and resting among the dead.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A pensive man sits in a sunlit stone courtyard beside the remains of a feast, a wine jug, a spilled cup and a flask of oil. A sparsely filled basket and an open purse with a few coins lie on the ground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the proverb’s warning that loving pleasure, wine and oil leads to want rather than riches.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone town gate, a smiling traveler reaches toward his family while guards hold a somber man behind him; hills and buildings glow in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a righteous person delivered while a wrongdoer is held, echoing the proverb’s contrast between the righteous and the wicked.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits quietly beside a simple shelter among dry rocks and scrub. In the distance, a woman gestures from the doorway of a stone house, with sunlit hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the proverb’s contrast between dwelling in the wilderness and living with a contentious, angry woman.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king in red and cream robes holds a hand over his heart beside stone-lined irrigation channels that curve and divide through a sunlit orchard, with a town and mountains beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene portraying the verse's comparison of a king's heart in Yahweh's hand to water channels He turns as He wishes.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, a man carefully tends a covered jar beside shelves of provisions while another man pours oil from a large jar onto the ground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the contrast between stores kept in the wise person's dwelling and the foolish person's squandering in Proverbs 21:20.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler pours water for a weary seated man beside a village path, while a donkey and villagers look on among fruit trees, flowers, and a flowing spring.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 21:21: the traveler’s care suggests pursuing righteousness and mercy, while the flourishing setting and welcoming villagers evoke life and honor.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man on a wooden ladder pulls stones from a fortified city wall as three armed guards look on in surprise; towers, a gate, trees, and distant hills fill the sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a wise man scaling the city of the mighty and bringing down its trusted stronghold, as described in Proverbs 21:22.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful man sits beneath a tree with a finger near his closed lips as two men argue in a sunlit stone village courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts restraint in speech amid a disagreement, reflecting the verse about guarding the mouth and tongue to keep oneself from troubles.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, an elaborately dressed man raises a dismissive hand and turns his chin upward as an older man gestures toward him; several villagers look on with concern.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the haughty scoffer acting with arrogant pride in Proverbs 21:24.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A dark-haired man in a blue tunic sits on a woven mat with his hands resting on his knees, gazing toward ripe grapes beyond an open gate. An empty bowl is in front of him, and a hoe leans against the courtyard wall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 21:25: the empty bowl, idle hands, and untouched hoe suggest the danger of desire without labor.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a man offers a loaf of bread to a seated woman while another man holds a full basket of bread close and watches. Baskets of bread, fruit, and a clay jug sit nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Proverbs 21:26, contrasting continual coveting with the righteous person's generous giving without withholding.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a robed man rests a hand on a white lamb beside a stone altar stacked with wood. He clutches a small pouch against his chest and glances sideways; trees, distant buildings, and mountains fill the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Proverbs 21:27, in which the sideways glance and clutched pouch suggest corrupt intent behind a sacrifice.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Under an olive tree beside a stone gateway, a seated man gestures as he talks with a white-bearded elder and a group of listeners; another man walks away with his head lowered.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Proverbs 21:28's contrast between a false witness who perishes and a person who hears and speaks enduringly.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A red-robed man strides with his chin raised while another man crouches to place a stone in a rocky path, with a sunlit village and hills behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 21:29 by contrasting a hardened face with the upright establishing his ways.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler stands at a fork in a sunlit, rocky landscape, while a bronze balance nearby holds a heart-shaped clay form in one pan.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 21:2, suggesting a person's chosen way and Yahweh's weighing of hearts.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Four robed advisers pause beside a low table with blank scrolls and small carved pieces, looking toward the sun over mountains and a valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts human counsel with a vast dawn-lit landscape, reflecting the verse's teaching that no wisdom, understanding, or counsel can prevail against Yahweh.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man adjusts the bridle of a saddled brown horse on a rocky hillside while three figures carrying spears and round shields stand above a sunlit valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a horse readied for battle recalls Proverbs 21:31's reminder that deliverance belongs to the LORD.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, an elderly man gives a small pouch to a seated woman while another man watches. A stone altar with grain stands behind them among trees and village buildings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses fair dealing and a nearby offering to evoke the verse's teaching that doing righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man lifts his chin proudly beside a wooden plow drawn by oxen through a field, where uprooted plants lie near a cultivated plot; another farmer watches from a short distance, with olive trees and a stone village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects a haughty look and proud heart with the verse’s image of the plowing of the wicked as sin; the damaged plants and watching farmer are invented details.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A farmer carefully sows orderly rows beside baskets of produce and gathered grain, while a hurried neighbor spills seed from a torn sack onto a rocky, sparse plot beside a nearly empty basket.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative farming scene reflects Proverbs 21:5's contrast between diligent plans leading to plenty and haste leading to poverty.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient market, a smiling merchant reaches toward gold coins while a wary buyer watches. Some of the treasure becomes a pale drifting mist beside a path overlooking a deep ravine.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 21:6, picturing treasures gained through a lying tongue as fleeting and connected with death.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men are swept through a torrent pouring from a broken stone wall, among bundles, a chest, and a clay jar. A man watches from higher ground near a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the violence of the wicked bringing destruction upon them as they refuse to do justice, as described in Proverbs 21:7.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit landscape of olive trees and hills, a man carrying a tied bundle walks along a winding dirt path while a stoneworker lays a straight paved path toward a village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the guilty person's crooked way with the upright work of the pure in Proverbs 21:8.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits quietly on a rooftop corner at sunset, overlooking a village. Below him, a woman gestures toward a seated man in a warmly lit room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting a quiet corner of a housetop with contention in a shared house, as in Proverbs 21:9.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a white-bearded elder gestures toward an open wooden gate as a grinning man walks away. Three seated neighbors converse calmly beneath a vine.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 22:10: a scoffer is sent away and the neighbors' contention, strife, and reproach give way to calm.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in a simple robe gestures as he speaks with a smiling, crowned king seated beside him on a cushioned bench in a sunlit stone garden with flowers and a fountain.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the verse's connection between love of purity of heart, gracious speech, and friendship with a king.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man points to a blank scroll beside a young listener in a sunlit stone courtyard, while another man whispers and a swirl of dust drifts between them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene: the sunlit scroll suggests the LORD's watchful preservation of knowledge, while the dissolving whisper suggests the overturning of the faithless person's words in Proverbs 22:12.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man sits in the doorway of a stone house, raising one hand toward a pale golden lion on a sunlit village street.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the lazy man's claim in Proverbs 22:13 that a lion is outside and he will be slain in the streets.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a red-brown cloak speaks from the edge of a deep rocky pit as a bearded man in a cream robe falls inside. A pale ribbon of breath winds from her mouth toward him; sunlit stone buildings, trees, and hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates Proverbs 22:14's comparison of the mouth of an immoral woman to a deep pit, into which the one under the LORD's displeasure falls.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder holding a wooden rod sits beside a boy on stone steps beneath an olive tree. A dark knot floats at the boy's chest, with strands drifting away; pottery, a village, and hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of Proverbs 22:15: the departing strands suggest foolishness being driven away from a child's heart through correction.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a worried man in worn clothing holds a few coins as a richly dressed man reaches toward them. The richly dressed man also presents a golden vessel and blue cloth to a seated wealthy man; an empty purse lies on the ground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the proverb's warning that oppressing the poor for gain and giving to the rich lead to poverty.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man with one hand over his chest leans toward an older man who speaks with open hands, while another bearded man sits between them beneath an olive tree in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of listening to the wise and taking knowledge to heart, reflecting Proverbs 22:17.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man rests one hand on his chest and gestures as he speaks to a young listener in a sunlit stone courtyard, with leafy vines, pottery, fruit, and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the pleasantness of keeping wisdom within and having it ready on the lips, as in Proverbs 22:18.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older bearded teacher gestures toward the sky while speaking with a younger man who listens with a hand on his chest; they sit beneath an olive tree overlooking a sunlit valley and village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of personal instruction in Proverbs 22:19, evoking teaching given today so the listener may trust in Yahweh.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling man in a cream robe is welcomed by neighbors in a sunlit stone village; an older man rests a hand on his shoulder, a woman reaches toward him, and an open chest of gold and silver stands nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative village welcome pictures the good name and loving favor valued above great riches, silver, and gold in Proverbs 22:1.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man holds a rolled parchment and gestures toward a younger man who listens. Another scroll, a reed pen, and an inkpot sit on a nearby table.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of shared written counsel and knowledge, reflecting Proverbs 22:20.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard beneath grapevines, an older teacher rests a hand on a young messenger’s shoulder as the messenger speaks with an open hand to two men seated across a wooden table. Pottery and a basket of fruit sit nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes learning truthful words and giving a truthful answer to those who sent the messenger, as in Proverbs 22:21.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man in worn clothing holds a small pouch at a stone city gate while a richly dressed man reaches toward it and an elder raises an open hand between them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 22:22 and its warning against robbing the poor and oppressing the afflicted at the gate.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone city gate, a modestly dressed couple appeal beside a balance scale while a richly dressed man recoils, coins spilling from a purse and an overturned hourglass at his feet; a scribe and guards are nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 22:23: the light and balance suggest the LORD pleading the wronged people's cause, while the spilled coins and fallen hourglass evoke judgment on those who plunder them and the loss of life.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a shoulder bag walks away on a sunlit path, looking back at an angry man who raises a fist and reaches toward him. Stone walls, olive trees, and a hillside village fill the landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of choosing not to accompany an angry person, echoing the warning in Proverbs 22:24.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man follows a scowling man along a sunlit olive-lined path, mirroring his raised fist while holding a cord that loops around his own sandal.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of the warning that learning another person's way can become a snare for one's own soul.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a richly dressed man extends his hand over a table of coins, a balance scale, and weights toward a man who raises an open palm; a worried third man watches with his hands clasped.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a man declining to stand surety for another's debt, reflecting Proverbs 22:26's warning against pledging hands for debts.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man sits on the floor holding an open empty purse while another man lifts a wooden bed with a woven mat in a modest room.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 22:27, where someone unable to pay risks having his bed taken from under him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man holding a staff gestures toward a weathered stone between a grain field and a vineyard, while a younger man crouches beside it; trees, hills, and a village lie beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating the warning in Proverbs 22:28 to leave an ancient boundary marker set by one's fathers in place.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woodworker stands before a seated, crowned king in a sunlit courtyard, presenting an intricately carved wooden chest. Woodworking tools and curled shavings lie on a table, and guards stand among stone columns behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of Proverbs 22:29, which describes a man skilled in his work standing before kings.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man in purple and a man in patched robes smile and clasp hands on a sunlit village path, with trees, hills, and stone houses behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined meeting of rich and poor reflects Proverbs 22:2: Yahweh is the maker of them all.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler crouches behind a large boulder, watching two other travelers stumble and shield themselves as rocks tumble onto a hillside road. Olive trees and a small village lie in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rockfall scene reflects Proverbs 22:3: the prudent person sees danger and takes shelter, while the simple continue and face its consequences.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man bows his head with clasped hands in a garden as a smiling man gestures toward him. Fruit, sheaves of wheat, and a pouch of coins lie nearby, with a young tree and flowing spring against a sunlit village landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 22:4: the bowed figure suggests humility and reverence for the Lord, while the harvest and coins, the neighbor's greeting, and the young tree and spring evoke riches, honor, and life.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler in robes walks along a clear sunlit path, looking toward a rocky path tangled with thorn bushes and rope snares. A village and mountains lie in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 22:5: the traveler stays away from thorns and snares, reflecting the verse's picture of guarding one's soul.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures along a winding path while walking beside a boy beneath an olive tree. Farther along, an elderly man with a walking stick heads toward a village among sunlit hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 22:6: a child is guided along a path while an older traveler continues on it, suggesting instruction that endures into old age.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man seated in a stone courtyard holds a coin purse and gestures toward a man in patched clothes carrying two clay jars on a shoulder yoke, with a sunlit village and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a borrower serving a lender illustrates Proverbs 22:7's description of the rich ruling over the poor and the borrower as servant to the lender.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A sorrowful man kneels in a dry field, scattering dark seeds beside withered thorn plants. A broken wooden rod lies across the foreground, with hills and a village in warm sunlight.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 22:8: sowing iniquity, reaping sorrow, and the failure of the rod of anger.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village, a man with a basket of bread offers a round loaf to a seated older man in worn clothes beside a stone house.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Proverbs 22:9, showing a generous person sharing his bread with someone in need.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler stands on a path beside a weathered upright boundary stone and a line of rocks, looking toward two children gathering grain in a golden field. A village and hills lie beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows a traveler respecting an old boundary stone while children harvest, reflecting the warning against moving ancient landmarks or entering the fields of the fatherless.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone town gate, a man stands beside a seated woman and child and extends an open hand toward another man, while three elders listen.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative hearing pictures Proverbs 23:11's mighty Redeemer pleading their cause against an opponent. The human advocate is a visual metaphor, not a literal portrait.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a young man rests a hand over his heart and listens as an older, bearded man gestures while speaking. Olive trees and distant buildings frame the scene.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures a listener receiving a teacher's words with heart and ears, reflecting the verse's call to attend to instruction and knowledge.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man and a boy sit together in a sunlit garden as the man gestures and holds a wooden rod against the ground. A young tree is tied to an upright stake nearby, with stone houses and hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 23:13's call not to withhold correction from a child. The resting rod recalls the verse's mention of a rod, and the supported sapling suggests guidance without showing the described striking.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man holding a long wooden rod points toward a sunlit path while a boy stands beside him near a dark, rocky pit, with hills and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative interpretation uses the lowered rod and the safe path to suggest the verse's connection between correction and deliverance from Sheol, represented by the dark pit.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard beneath an olive tree, a smiling man rests a hand over his heart as he watches an older boy share bread with a younger child.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined act of generosity suggests a son's wise heart and his father's joy, reflecting Proverbs 23:15.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man gestures as he speaks to a smiling older man, who rests a hand on his chest in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath an olive tree.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation illustrates the verse's inward joy when another person speaks what is right.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village market, a young person rests a hand over their heart and looks upward. Nearby, a merchant handles a grain scale beside stacks of coins, sacks of grain, and baskets of produce.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined marketplace scene pictures a young person looking upward instead of toward a merchant manipulating a scale, suggesting reverence for the Lord throughout the day rather than envy of the sinful.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a staff gently holds a leafy olive branch beside a large olive tree, looking toward the sun over a valley and a winding path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a living olive branch and a path toward the horizon to suggest the verse's promise of a future and hope that will not be cut off.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man and a boy sit on rocks under a tree. The boy touches his chest and looks up as the man gestures toward a winding path through olive trees to a distant village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures a father counseling his listening son. The path and the son's hand over his heart evoke Proverbs 23:19's call to be wise and guide one's heart in the way.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A simply dressed man rests his chin on his hand as he studies a meal at a table beside a richly dressed, crowned ruler. Bread, roast meat, fruit, bowls, and golden vessels fill the table in a sunlit, columned setting.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 23:1, in which a guest is urged to consider carefully what is before him when eating with a ruler.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler raises a hand and walks away from a feast as a guest offers him a cup, while another reaches for a platter of roast meat among clay jugs and cups.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the verse's warning against joining those who drink wine and eat meat to excess.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in a torn tunic sleeps at a wooden table in a sunlit room. Nearly empty dishes, food remnants, a clay jug and cup, and an open pouch with a few coins lie on the table.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Proverbs 23:21's warning about drunkenness, gluttony and drowsiness leading to poverty, using torn clothing, meal remnants and a nearly empty pouch.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a young man listens to an older man speaking while holding the hand of a silver-haired elderly woman seated between them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative family scene depicts a son listening to his father and treating his elderly mother with care, reflecting Proverbs 23:22.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village marketplace, a young learner holds a glowing clay lamp and raises a hand toward a merchant offering coins. Nearby, an older teacher and a child explore wooden shapes together.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures truth as a lamp kept despite an offer of money, while the lesson with wooden shapes evokes wisdom, instruction, and understanding.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling older man watches as a young man and an elderly woman carry a basket of fruit together in a sunlit stone village courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined act of kindness illustrates a father rejoicing in his righteous and wise child; the verse does not describe this particular event.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling mother embraces her grown son as his father smiles beside them in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath an olive tree.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family reunion pictures the gladness of the father and the rejoicing of the mother who bore the child in Proverbs 23:25.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling son walks beside his father on a sunlit country path, one hand over his heart, watching as his father gestures toward the winding road and village ahead.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the son offering his heart through a gesture of trust and looking with delight toward his father and his ways.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler walks along a sunlit path, looking back toward a woman gesturing from another path beyond a deep pit. A narrow stone well stands in the foreground, with hills and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the verse's comparisons of a harlot to a deep pit and a seductress to a narrow well; the traveler takes a safe path away from the hazards.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunset, a woman watches from a stone doorway as three men walk along a village path; two hold the frayed ends of a broken cord between them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the verse's woman lying in wait; the broken cord suggests the increase of unfaithfulness among people.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a weary, red-eyed man with a bandaged forearm sits beside a concerned woman. Two men gesture tensely in the background, and a cracked clay vessel lies on the ground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the verse's questions about sorrow, contention, complaints, wounds without cause, and reddened eyes. The bandage and cracked vessel suggest distress without showing an injury occurring.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A diner in purple and gold raises an open hand as a server offers a platter of food across a banquet table set with bread, grapes, figs, and other dishes in a sunlit, columned palace.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of the verse's warning about appetite and the need for self-restraint, rather than a literal depiction of every word.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Five adults linger around a low table in a stone courtyard as dawn approaches. One adds herbs to a bowl of red wine beside clay cups and a jug, while an oil lamp burns and grapevines hang overhead.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts people lingering over wine and seeking mixed wine, with the fading night suggesting time spent at the table.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a robed man turns his body away and raises one hand, glancing back toward a golden cup of sparkling, swirling red wine on a table beside grapes and figs.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the warning in Proverbs 23:31 through a man leaving the alluring, sparkling red wine untouched.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunset, a startled man steps back from a coiled viper on a stone table beside an overturned golden cup spilling red liquid. Grapevines frame the courtyard and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene presents the serpent and viper as a warning of a danger revealed at the last, echoing the verse's comparison to a bite and sting. The person remains unharmed.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A wide-eyed man sits at a low table and looks toward floating pottery and leafy branches, while a dark curling ribbon emerges from his open mouth. A clay cup and fruit rest on the table, with a village and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the verse's strange sights with floating objects and its twisted speech with a tangled ribbon from the man's mouth.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man reclines in a rope hammock high beside the mast of a wooden sailing boat, surrounded by rolling blue waves under a golden sunset.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative interpretation of the verse's comparison of lying in the midst of the sea and lying at the top of a mast; the hammock presents the precarious image through a resting figure.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A weary man sits awake on a woven mat in a sunlit room, reaching toward a cup and jug on a low table. An overturned cup lies beside his rumpled blanket.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the waking man's reach and the overturned cup to evoke the verse's warning about seeking another drink despite harm he did not feel.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone room, a seated guest raises a hand as a richly dressed man offers a platter of bread, fruit and other delicacies. A gray looped shape lies on the tablecloth beneath the platter.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: In this imaginative interpretation, the guest declines the tempting delicacies while the loop suggests a snare, illustrating Proverbs 23:3's warning that such food can be deceptive.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated merchant rests his chin on one hand and places the other on the lid of a chest of coins. A balance scale and weights sit on the table in front of him, and an open doorway looks out onto sunlit fields, a village, and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows a merchant pausing over his wealth, reflecting the verse's call to cease overworking to become rich and to step back from one's own understanding. It does not portray a literal event narrated in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man on a stone terrace reaches toward a winged purse of gold coins flying into the sky; an open chest with a few coins rests beside him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures riches making wings and flying away like an eagle, as in Proverbs 23:5.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone room, a guest raises a hand to decline while a stern host guards bread and grapes at a table spread with figs, dates, olives, and other food.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows a guest declining a watchful host's food, illustrating Proverbs 23:6's warning against eating a miser's bread or desiring his delicacies.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard beneath grapevines, a man gestures across a table of bread and fruit while holding a tied pouch close to his chest; the man opposite holds a cup.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the host's guarded pouch to suggest that his inner concern differs from his invitation to eat and drink, echoing the verse's contrast between speech and heart.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, a man holds his stomach and gestures toward another man who looks away, beside a low table with a nearly empty dish and falling pink petals.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: In this imaginative interpretation, the diner's discomfort after eating suggests the morsel brought back up, while his unanswered gesture and the falling petals suggest pleasant words wasted.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a seated man holding a lit clay lamp looks toward another seated man, who turns away with a frown and a raised palm. Clay vessels, greenery, and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the warning against speaking wisdom to a fool who would despise it. The lamp suggests wisdom, and the other man turns away dismissively.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A weary traveler sits beneath a rocky shelter beside a lantern, looking toward a rain-swept road through the hills as sunlight breaks through distant storm clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a weary traveler and a stormy road to picture fainting in a day of adversity and the smallness of strength described in Proverbs 24:10.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit stone path beside a damaged wooden bridge over a ravine, a man holds the hand of a weary traveler while a woman steadies the traveler from behind.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses helping travelers beside a damaged bridge to reflect the verse’s call to deliver and hold back those in danger.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit village path, a man gestures with open hands while a woman pours water for a seated traveler beneath a tree. A brass balance in the foreground holds a heart-shaped stone and an olive sprig.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pairs a gesture of uncertainty with an act of kindness and a symbolic scale, reflecting the verse's account of God weighing hearts, knowing, and rendering according to deeds.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father smiles and gestures toward his son, who tastes a piece of honeycomb at a wooden table in a sunlit village courtyard. A bowl of honey and honeycomb rests in front of them, with olive trees and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a father encouraging his son to taste honeycomb, reflecting the verse's invitation to eat honey and its sweetness to the taste.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young learner tends an olive sapling beside an older teacher on a flowered hillside, while a stone-lined path winds toward a sunlit valley and distant mountains.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the learner and growing olive tree with finding wisdom, and the path toward the horizon with the verse's future and enduring hope.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man beside a low stone wall looks back toward a peaceful stone house, where another man rests on a shaded terrace among pottery and plants in a sunlit hillside landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the warning against lying in wait for the dwelling of the righteous or plundering his resting place; the home and resting man remain unharmed.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed traveler braces a hand on a rock as he rises on a sunlit, stony hillside path. In the distance, two other travelers stumble among fallen branches under a rainstorm, with a village and mountains beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the righteous rising after repeated falls and the wicked stumbling in calamity; the rocky paths and storm are visual interpretations of the proverb.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit stone village path, a standing man clasps the hand of a man seated on the ground beside a tipped basket of spilled figs. Stone walls, olive trees, village houses, and hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene responds to the verse's warning against rejoicing at an enemy's fall: one imagined rival helps the other after a harmless stumble.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling man stands with folded arms while another man gathers figs beside an overturned basket on a village path. Sunlight falls on the seated man as a dark rain cloud hangs over distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene uses a retreating storm as a metaphor for Yahweh turning His wrath away after seeing what displeases Him; the spilled figs depict trouble without injury.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village market, a traveler gathers spilled fruit beside an older woman while two richly dressed merchants stand behind a balance across from a customer.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures a peaceful response to wrongdoing and wealth, reflecting the verse’s counsel not to fret because of evildoers or envy the wicked.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young traveler carrying a basket walks along a sunlit village street, looking back at three richly dressed men who gesture to him from a market stall filled with fine goods.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays a traveler passing by an inviting group, reflecting the verse's warning against envying evil people or seeking their company.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An extinguished clay oil lamp sends up a curl of smoke from a stone ledge as a robed figure looks toward a winding path through shadowed hills at sunset.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene uses the extinguished lamp and fading path to picture the verse’s warning that the wicked have no prospect and their lamp will be put out.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit village road, a father speaks with his hand on his son's shoulder while three men gesture from a separate path. A crowned king on horseback stands near the city gate in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures a father advising his son to revere the LORD and the king and to avoid the company of those given to change.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two travelers shelter in a stone doorway, watching dark storm clouds gather over a sunlit village market where baskets and produce lie scattered beside an overturned stall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a sudden storm and a disrupted market to suggest the verse's warning of calamity arising unexpectedly and ruin that cannot be foreknown. The travelers are not identified with the verse's 'two.'

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a stone table in a town gate, an elder gestures toward a richly dressed man and a man in worn clothing, with a balanced scale between them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative hearing illustrates the verse's warning that showing partiality in judgment is not good.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated judge gestures approvingly toward a richly dressed man at an ancient stone town gate, while nearby townspeople look back with disapproval or turn away. An overturned balance and scattered coins lie in front of the judge.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a judge praising a wrongdoer and people rejecting his judgment, reflecting Proverbs 24:24.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village market, two men gesture toward a balance scale as they speak with a seated merchant, while a smiling woman and two children hold a basket of fruit and bread.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures people correcting wrongdoing and receiving a good blessing through the gratitude of their neighbors, reflecting Proverbs 24:25.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two adult men in robes kiss and embrace while seated beneath an olive tree in a sunlit stone courtyard, with a clay cup nearby and hills and a village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the proverb's comparison of a right answer to a kiss on the lips as an affectionate exchange between friends.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A farmer hoes rows of young plants in a sunny field. Beside the field, stones outline an empty house site, with building stones and timber stacked nearby; hills and a village lie in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays preparing work in the field before building a house, as the proverb instructs.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient village gateway, a thoughtful man rests a hand near his chin while another man gestures beside him; two seated men listen. Stone buildings, pottery, woven textiles and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays a witness pausing before speaking about a neighbor, reflecting the verse’s warning against baseless testimony and deceptive speech.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man holds up open hands beside an overturned clay jar spilling water, while another man stands near an upright jar with an uneasy expression.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a spilled jar and a calm response to picture the verse's warning against repaying another person in kind.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient village, one man whispers to another and points toward a wooden gate; baskets, pottery, stone walls, trees, and distant mountains surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests people devising harm inwardly and speaking of trouble, as described in Proverbs 24:2, through a whispered conversation rather than an act of violence.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler walks beside a weedy field and tangled grapevines, observing idle tools and a tipped basket in a sunlit hillside landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the speaker passing the field and vineyard described in Proverbs 24:30; the tangled growth and idle tools suggest neglect.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A sunlit plot is densely overgrown with thorny brambles and leafy weeds. Its low stone wall has collapsed in the foreground, leaving scattered stones at the breach, with hills and a village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the verse’s ground covered with thorns and nettles and its broken stone wall.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler pauses with a hand at his chin, studying an overgrown field and a broken stone wall in a sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the verse’s movement from careful observation and reflection to receiving instruction; the setting is an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sleeps on a woven mat beneath a tree with his hands folded over his chest. A hoe, basket and clay jar rest among weeds beside him, with golden fields, hills and a village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the verse's sleep, slumber and folded hands at rest; the unattended tools and rural setting are artistic additions.
