records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man stands beside a large open jar, holding a basket with a few grains, while a cloaked figure carrying a round shield approaches along a path beyond a stone wall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures poverty and need arriving like a prowler and an armed man, with sparse provisions and a distant shield-bearing figure.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man and woman carefully set a stone in the foundation of a house under construction, with a plumb line, building tools, olive trees and sunlit hills around them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the verse's house being built through wisdom and established by understanding as two builders carefully set its foundation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit home with several adjoining rooms, an older man guides a younger woman as she arranges a colorful woven textile on a shelf. Pottery, carved chests, flowers, fruit, baskets and textiles fill the rooms.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents knowledge shared through teaching and rooms filled with precious and pleasant riches; its people and furnishings are artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man uses a long wooden lever to lift a large stone onto a low stone wall while a boy watches nearby, with olive trees and sunlit village buildings in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a lever to picture how knowledge can increase strength, reflecting the proverb about a wise and knowledgeable man.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A leader listens to four counselors around a model of the landscape on a stone terrace, with shields and spears nearby and a guarded city gate in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays a leader seeking several counselors before war, with the guarded city suggesting the safety associated with their counsel in Proverbs 24:6.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A silent man looks up at a lit oil lamp on a high stone ledge while three elders converse beside an ancient city gate.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene places a silent man at the gate and uses a high lamp to suggest wisdom beyond his reach, reflecting Proverbs 24:7.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man crouches behind a stone wall holding a sack and looking toward baskets of produce in a sunny village market. Two villagers speak together nearby, while a vendor tends the produce.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined marketplace scene depicts a man contemplating theft as others notice and speak together, illustrating the proverb about one who plots evil being called a schemer.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a smirking man arranges pebbles on a wooden table and gestures dismissively as several neighbors turn away with troubled or disapproving expressions.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses pebbles to suggest foolish devising and the neighbors' reactions to suggest the community's rejection of a scoffer in Proverbs 24:9.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a downcast man holds an open pouch as feathers scatter in the breeze. Another man raises a hand toward him, while villagers look on.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a listener's reproach and scattering feathers to picture the verse's warning about exposed shame and a damaged reputation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men converse in a sunlit courtyard, one gesturing as the other listens. Golden apple-shaped ornaments rest in an ornate silver openwork setting on the table before them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pairs a thoughtful conversation with golden apples in a silver setting, reflecting the verse's comparison of a fittingly spoken word to that beautiful arrangement.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man gestures as he speaks to a younger man who listens with his chin resting on his hand. The listener wears a gold earring, and a gold ornament rests in an open box on a nearby table.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays wise correction received by a listening ear as precious as a gold earring and ornament.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling messenger offers a small pouch to a seated man and woman beside a golden harvest field; a clay vessel filled with snow rests in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pairs a faithful messenger returning to those who sent him with the refreshing cold of snow during harvest, echoing the verse’s comparison.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling man gestures grandly beside an empty woven basket as another man holds out his hands. Wind lifts the first man's headcloth beneath large clouds over a dry village and golden fields.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects an empty promised gift with the verse's comparison to wind and clouds that bring no rain.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man gestures gently as a crowned ruler listens from his chair. A broken bone and a sprig of flowers rest on a table in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts patient, gentle speech persuading a ruler; the broken bone beside flowers suggests the verse's image of gentleness overcoming hardness.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated traveler holds a small piece of honeyed bread and raises a hand toward a clay jar of honey and a dish of honeycomb. Bread and a cup rest on a stone table beneath a tree, with a sunlit village and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows a traveler setting aside more honey after taking a little, reflecting the verse's counsel to eat only enough to avoid the unpleasant consequences of excess.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A visitor waves as he walks away from a stone house, while a woman watches from its doorway. Clay pots, olive trees and a sunlit village surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows a visitor giving a neighbor space, reflecting the proverb’s warning that too-frequent visits can wear out a welcome.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient village, a standing man points as three seated elders listen and another man sits with his head lowered. A wooden club, a sheathed sword, and an arrow rest on a stone in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents false testimony against a neighbor and the verse’s comparison to a club, sword, and sharp arrow. The weapons rest unused to suggest the harm of false witness without depicting injury.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated traveler reaches toward a man walking away along a rocky path beneath gathering storm clouds. A loose sandal and a cracked tooth-shaped clay object lie in the foreground, with a sunlit village and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays reliance on someone who turns away in trouble; the broken sandal and cracked tooth-shaped object recall the proverb’s comparisons to an unsound foot and a bad tooth.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone archive, a man holds an open scroll beside a scribe writing on another, while two more men work among shelves and bundles of scrolls.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the men of Hezekiah, king of Judah, copying Solomon’s proverbs in Proverbs 25:1.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a snowy stone courtyard, a sorrowful seated man rests his head on his hand while a smiling musician sings and plays a lyre nearby. Another man carries away a red cloak, and liquid pours from a clay pitcher into a fizzing bowl on a low table.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings together the proverb’s comparisons: singing to a heavy heart, taking away a garment in cold weather, and vinegar on soda.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a rocky village path, a standing man offers a round loaf and a cup of water to a weary seated man, beneath an olive tree with hills and stone buildings beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Proverbs 25:21’s instruction to give bread and water to a hungry and thirsty enemy; the people and setting are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman offers bread and a clay pitcher to a seated man while glowing coals float above his head without touching him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the verse’s coals as a harmless symbol above the man and uses sunlight on the giver to suggest Yahweh’s reward.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a man whispers to a seated companion while a woman beside baskets of olives looks back at them angrily. Wind lifts cloth and drives rain from dark clouds over distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene pairs wind and rain with whispered backbiting and an angry face, echoing the comparison in Proverbs 25:23.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunset, a man sits quietly on a mat in the corner of a flat roof behind a low stone parapet, while a woman gestures upward from the open room below.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts the quiet rooftop corner with the contentious shared house described in Proverbs 25:24.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated traveler holds a cup beside a flowing spring and smiles toward a joyful messenger approaching along a winding road from a distant hilltop settlement.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects a refreshing drink for a weary traveler with the joy of good news arriving from a distant land.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man steps back from a stern, richly dressed man beside a stone-lined pool of swirling muddy water, with a village and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pairs a man yielding before an imposing figure with a muddy spring, echoing the verse’s comparison of a righteous person faltering before the wicked to polluted water.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful man sits at a courtyard table crowded with overflowing jars of honey, holding a honey dipper above a bowl. A large golden wreath rests on a nearby stool, with hills and a village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the excess honey with the verse’s warning and uses the unattended wreath to suggest the futility of seeking one’s own glory.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man in ancient clothing stands in a gust of wind beside a wide breach in a stone wall, with fallen blocks and a city visible beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the broken city wall in Proverbs 25:28; the swirling wind suggests a spirit without restraint.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king in a sunlit palace courtyard lifts a cloth to examine a partly concealed carved object on a stone table, with mountains and golden clouds beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the partly covered object and the king's careful investigation to picture the verse's contrast between God's glory in concealing a matter and kings' glory in searching it out.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king stands thoughtfully on a stone terrace overlooking a deep rocky valley, distant mountains, and a vast sunlit sky filled with clouds.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pairs the height of the sky and the depth of the earth with a king whose inward thoughts remain unseen, reflecting the verse’s comparison to the unsearchable heart of kings.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A silversmith lifts dark dross from a glowing crucible of silver in a sunlit workshop; a silver bracelet rests on a cloth nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative workshop scene illustrates the verse’s removal of dross from silver and the silversmith’s resulting jewelry.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A king sits on a carved stone throne and listens to a family in his sunlit court while an attendant guides a robed courtier toward an open doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the removal of the wicked from the king’s presence and a throne established in righteousness through a peaceful departure and the king’s attentive hearing.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A modestly dressed visitor stands with hands folded near the entrance of a sunlit royal hall, facing a crowned king and dignitaries seated on an elevated platform.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the verse's counsel against exalting oneself before a king or taking the place of the great: the visitor remains respectfully apart from the elevated seats.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit gathering hall, a seated noble on a raised platform extends his hand toward a guest standing below; an empty cushioned place rests beside the noble as other guests watch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the verse’s invitation to come up before a prince, rather than being put lower in his presence.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone town gate, a man pauses and raises a hand toward his neighbor, who holds a stone; three seated elders watch them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays a pause before a dispute, reflecting the warning against rushing to court and later being put to shame by a neighbor.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men sit facing each other in a sunlit stone courtyard; one gestures as he speaks, while the other listens. A closed clay jar rests between them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures neighbors discussing a dispute directly. The closed jar suggests keeping another person's confidence private.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a steward gives coins to two workers beside an overturned basket of fruit and a broken wooden fence, with fields, trees, birds and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the supplied glosses about God forming everything and giving wages to the fool and the transgressor. The landscape suggests creation, while a human steward and the workers' surroundings picture the giving of wages.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunny stone courtyard, a dog lowers its head to a small patch of vomit while a man pours water into a cracked clay jar that leaks onto the ground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the verse's dog returning to its vomit and represents repeated folly through a man pouring water into a leaking jar.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a man admires himself in a bronze hand mirror while an older man gestures toward him. Nearby, another seated man listens to an older man beside a green shoot.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts a man absorbed in his own reflection with a listener and a growing shoot, suggesting the greater hope the proverb holds out for a fool than for someone wise in his own eyes.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A worried man sits in a stone doorway beside a basket and unused tools, gesturing toward a lion-shaped shadow stretching across a sunlit village street.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the lion as a shadow of the lazy man's excuse for staying inside, reflecting his warning of a lion in the road and streets.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A sleepy man lies on his side under a patterned blanket in a sunlit room, beside a partly open wooden door with visible iron hinges.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pairs the man on his bed with a door on its hinges, illustrating the verse’s comparison of turning in place.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A weary-looking man slumps at a low table in a warm, sunlit room, his head resting on one hand while his other hand sits in a bowl of food. Bread, vegetables, pottery and woven textiles surround him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the proverb’s lazy man with his hand in the bowl, reluctant to bring it back to his mouth.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a smiling man reclines on cushions beside a basket, raising a hand toward seven people gathered around him. One man gestures as if explaining while the others watch.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene portrays the lazy man dismissing seven thoughtful respondents, illustrating the verse’s contrast between his opinion of his own wisdom and those who answer sensibly.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler with a staff pauses beside an alert dog and watches a man and woman arguing in a sunlit village street.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene places a passerby and an unharmed dog beside another pair's quarrel, evoking the verse's comparison between meddling and taking a dog by its ears.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in ancient clothing throws a flaming firebrand as arrows fly toward a burning wooden practice target in a rocky, sunlit landscape.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the verse’s reckless throwing of firebrands and arrows; the burning empty target suggests their deadly danger without depicting injury.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling man shrugs and lifts a cloth from an empty woven basket while another man looks at it with a troubled expression and open hands.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative empty-basket trick portrays the verse's warning about deceiving a neighbor and then claiming it was only a joke.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An imaginative countryside scene with incongruous snow, rain, harvest and an oversized wreath.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This verse contains no verbs or marked form changes.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two smiling neighbors sit together in a sunlit village courtyard beside a stone fire pit containing ashes, a few glowing embers, and a wisp of smoke; a figure walks away down the path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pairs an unfed, fading fire with neighbors at peace as a figure departs, reflecting the proverb’s comparison between a fire without wood and strife without a talebearer.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three men gesture in a heated disagreement in a sunlit village courtyard beside a stone hearth containing burning wood, glowing coals and charcoal. A bowl of charcoal and a basket of firewood sit nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pairs a quarrel with fuel feeding a hearth to illustrate the proverb’s comparison: a contentious person kindles strife as charcoal and wood feed fire.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man whispers to a seated man while offering a dish of sweets. The listener holds a morsel near his mouth and rests his other hand on his abdomen; grapes and pottery surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the talebearer's tempting words as sweet morsels taken inward, echoing the verse's comparison.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit pottery workshop, an animated merchant gestures toward a listening customer while holding a dark heart-shaped stone. A silver-coated clay vessel on the table has a patch of exposed earthenware, with silvery flakes scattered nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the verse's comparison: the silver-coated earthenware echoes fervent lips that can conceal a wicked heart, represented by the dark stone.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a smiling man gestures as he speaks to a listening neighbor while hiding a small scowling mask behind his back. Olive branches, pottery, village houses and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene uses the hidden mask to suggest the hatred and deceit concealed behind pleasant speech in Proverbs 26:24; the mask is not described in the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling man offers flowers to a wary listener. Behind the speaker, a heart-shaped shadow contains seven dark thorn-like shapes.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts a speaker's gracious manner with the hidden evil in his heart, reflecting the verse's warning against trusting kind words alone.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a man lifts a patterned red cloth from a table of spoiled produce while a group of neighbors watches with concern.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses spoiled produce revealed beneath a handsome cloth to picture hatred concealed by deceit and wickedness exposed before an assembly.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man stands thoughtfully near an empty dug pit and a resting spade, while a large stone sits at the foot of a tracked hillside in a sunlit countryside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative interpretation of the pit and returning stone in Proverbs 26:27: the empty pit and stone suggest a harmful scheme returning to its maker, while the observer remains safe.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village pottery courtyard, a smiling, richly dressed man gestures toward a distressed potter beside a shattered clay jar and spilled grain. A mirror held behind the man's back shows an angry face.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a smiling speaker, a hostile reflection, and a broken jar to suggest the verse's warning that lying and flattering speech harm others and bring ruin.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in a sunlit stone courtyard watches a brown sparrow and a fork-tailed swallow flying past above an open gateway, with flowers, hills and a distant village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows the sparrow and swallow passing without landing, echoing the verse's comparison to a curse without cause that does not alight.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village stable yard, a coiled whip hangs beside a horse and a handler holds a bridled donkey. A man looks back beside a basket of spilled grain, with a wooden rod resting against the wall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative stable scene places the verse's whip, horse, bridle, donkey and rod together; the unused rod and spilled grain suggest the warning about correction without depicting harm.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man speaks with both hands raised while another man faces him quietly with his hands clasped low.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the warning against answering folly in the same manner and becoming like the fool.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling man gestures proudly toward a crooked stack of stones while another man kneels beside it, points at the stones and holds a straight wooden rod.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures a calm answer that exposes a foolish claim, so the speaker does not remain wise in his own eyes.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a concerned man reaches toward a distracted messenger walking away as a rolled parchment falls from his hand. A cart with a detached wheel and an overturned clay vessel spilling dark liquid sit in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the danger of sending a message by a fool: the dropped scroll suggests a failed errand, the detached wheel a journey unable to proceed, and the spilled drink the harmful consequences. No injury is depicted.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a gesturing speaker holds up a wooden marionette with dangling legs while four listeners watch. Grapevines, pottery and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a puppet's dangling legs and an ineffectual speaker to picture the verse's comparison between limp legs and a proverb in the mouth of fools.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman places a leafy wreath on a smiling seated man beside a spilled basket of fruit. In the foreground, a stone is tied into the pouch of a sling resting on a stone ledge.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pairs a stone bound in a resting sling with a wreath of honor given to a carefree man, reflecting the proverb’s comparison about giving honor to a fool.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling man holds a thorny branch and gestures to two seated listeners beside an overturned wine jug.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the verse’s comparison of a thorn in a drunkard’s hand to a proverb in the mouths of fools. The branch is held without injury.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Outside a stone house, a woman offers a steaming bowl and blanket to a woman and child beside storm-damaged shelter, while an older man stands in the doorway with a basket of food. A winding path leads toward distant houses across the hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts nearby neighbors and an older friend offering help after a storm, reflecting the verse's counsel to keep friendships and the value of a nearby neighbor in a day of trouble. The distant houses suggest a brother far away.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man pours water into a seated older man’s cup in a sunlit stone courtyard. Behind them, a smiling man holds a hand to his heart while speaking with an elder.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays a son’s kindness as a wise action that gladdens his father and gives him an answer to someone who reproaches him.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler shelters beneath a rocky overhang as two other travelers carry bundles along a hillside road through heavy rain, with a village and hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a storm and soaked bundles to picture the prudent person taking shelter from danger while others continue and suffer consequences.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a worried man passes a folded red garment across a table to a seated man, while a traveler and a woman watch nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the garment held as a pledge from someone who stood surety for another; the figures and setting are an interpretation of the verse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunrise in a stone village, a smiling man calls out with one hand raised while a weary man at an open window covers his ear. A rooster stands nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the proverb’s loud early-morning blessing as an unwelcome greeting to a sleepy friend, echoing how it may be counted as a curse.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Inside a warmly lit home, a woman gestures as she speaks to a weary seated man. Rain falls outside the doorway while drops from the roof land in a pottery bowl.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene places an insistent exchange beside a persistent roof leak on a rainy day, reflecting the comparison in Proverbs 27:15.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man reaches toward windblown olive leaves and cloth while golden oil drips between the fingers of his other hand beside a clay jar.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the verse's comparison through wind that cannot be caught and oil slipping from a right hand.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village workshop, a man works a blade against a rectangular sharpening surface while a smiling friend watches and gestures beside him. Tools hang on the wall and lie on the bench, with a village visible beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative workshop scene connects the sharpening of a blade with the verse's image of iron sharpening iron and friends sharpening one another.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated man holds a bitten fig beneath a fruit-laden fig tree while a standing man rests a hand on his shoulder. A basket of figs sits nearby in a sunlit stone courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the keeper enjoying the fig tree’s fruit with the honor given to one who serves his master.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A thoughtful man kneels beside a stone-edged garden pool, one hand over his chest, as his face is reflected in the water. A woman sits nearby among flowers and stone buildings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pairs a face reflected in water with a hand over the heart, suggesting the verse’s comparison between reflection and how the heart reveals a person.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two robed travelers pause beside a packed bundle on a sunlit hillside. One gestures toward a winding road that crosses an olive-covered valley and disappears into mist among distant hills, while the other sits looking toward it.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a journey and a road disappearing into mist to reflect the warning against boasting about tomorrow, since we do not know what a day may bring.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man stands among fruit, pottery and colorful fabrics in an ancient marketplace, gazing toward a distant sunlit city beyond a deep ravine and ruined stone buildings.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pairs the man’s restless gaze amid abundance with a seemingly bottomless ravine and ruins, suggesting the verse’s comparison between eyes that are never satisfied and Sheol and destruction that are never full.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A metalsmith holds tongs over a glowing silver-filled pot while three neighbors gesture appreciatively toward him. A bright furnace and a gold vessel stand beside him in a sunlit workshop.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative workshop scene pairs silver in a refining pot and gold by a furnace with a craftsman receiving praise, reflecting the verse's comparison between precious metals and a person in relation to praise.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, an elder gestures toward a seated man who turns away with folded arms. Between them is a stone mortar filled with crushed grain and a knotted piece of wood; a wooden pestle lies in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the knot remaining among crushed grain and a man turning from counsel to suggest the verse's warning that foolishness does not depart through grinding.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd kneels in a sunlit pasture and gently examines a sheep, while other sheep and goats graze or rest near a stone sheepfold, olive trees, and distant hills and village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the verse's call to know the condition of the flocks and give attention to the herds through a shepherd's careful examination of a sheep.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man and a child sit together in a stone courtyard, looking toward a jeweled crown, scattered coins, and an open empty chest, with a palace and village beyond at sunset.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the crown, dwindled treasure, and two generations to evoke the verse's warning that riches and a crown do not endure forever.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man carries an armful of golden cut hay across a harvested hillside where tender green shoots appear, while a woman gathers herbs into a basket among rocks and flowers beneath distant mountains.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings together the verse's removed hay, emerging tender grass, and herbs gathered from the mountains.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd displays a woven woolen cloth beside lambs; nearby, a man with two goats speaks with another man gesturing toward a cultivated field, with hills and a village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects lambs with clothing and pictures goats as the price of a field, following Proverbs 27:26.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman pours milk from a clay pitcher into a bowl while people gather at a table with bread and bowls of milk; goats stand nearby and in the field beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the verse's goats' milk nourishing a household and its maidservants.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a smiling traveler with a walking staff gestures toward a wooden stool and its maker, who stands with hands folded and head modestly lowered.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows another person praising an artisan's work while the artisan listens, reflecting the proverb's call to let another praise you rather than your own lips.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a wooden balance holds a large stone and a sack of sand on its raised pan and a dark tangled bundle on its lowered pan. An angry man gestures beside it while another man watches with concern.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the lowered bundle as a picture of a fool's wrath weighing more heavily than stone and sand.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A frowning man leans on a stone terrace and looks toward a smiling man carrying a basket of fruit along a village path. A foaming torrent rushes through a rocky ravine beneath a dark, thorn-shaped storm cloud.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pairs a raging torrent with a jealous observer and a looming thorn-shaped cloud to reflect the verse's warning about wrath, anger, and the overwhelming force of jealousy.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunny village courtyard, a man holding a clay jug points toward a wilted plant as another man sits listening thoughtfully. A bouquet peeks out from beneath a folded cloth on a nearby bench.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays a friend giving open, caring correction about a neglected plant, while the hidden bouquet suggests love kept concealed, reflecting the verse's comparison.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village garden, a man points to a traveler's cloak caught in a thorny bramble while the traveler looks back at him. A third man leans toward the traveler for a kiss and hides wilted flowers behind his back.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a snagged cloak and a hidden wilted bouquet to picture the contrast between a friend's faithful, difficult help and an enemy's deceitful affection in Proverbs 27:6.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a reclining man turns away from a dish of honeycomb beside a plentiful meal, while a traveler seated nearby eats greens from a bowl.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts a satisfied person turning away from honeycomb with a hungry traveler enjoying bitter greens, reflecting the proverb's contrast between fullness and hunger.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bird flies from a woven nest in an olive tree as a traveler with a staff looks toward it on a path beside a stone home, with golden fields and hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pairs a bird leaving its nest with a traveler away from his place, echoing the comparison in Proverbs 27:8.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two friends sit together in a sunlit stone courtyard, smiling as one speaks with an open hand and rests the other on his friend’s shoulder. A small open clay bowl, a perfume vessel, and fragrant herbs sit on a low table beside them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the pleasure of ointment and perfume with the sweetness of a friend’s heartfelt counsel in Proverbs 27:9.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward a shaded rocky path as he looks down at a striped satchel in a pit strewn with branches; two travelers walk along a sunny path beside a fruit orchard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the guide's satchel in his own pit to suggest the warning about the one who leads the upright astray; the travelers' sunny orchard suggests the good inherited by the blameless.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed man admires himself in a bronze mirror beside a chest of coins, while a man in patched clothing watches him in a sunlit stone marketplace.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the mirror to suggest the rich man's confidence in his own wisdom, while the poorer man's attentive gaze suggests the understanding that searches him out.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient village square, adults and children rejoice while robed figures ascend stone steps. Nearby, a woman shelters a child beside a doorway as a man peers out.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts the joy and glory of the righteous with villagers seeking shelter as the wicked rise, echoing Proverbs 28:12.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village market, a man holds one hand to his chest while placing an open pouch of coins on a stall. A woman behind the stall reaches toward him with open hands, beside a folded cloth and baskets of fruit.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene of returning what was concealed and being met with compassion illustrates the verse's contrast between covering sins and confessing and forsaking them to receive mercy.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit, rocky road, a traveler looks upward with one hand over his heart, while another man sits with folded arms on a wooden cart stuck in a muddy rut, with fruit and baskets spilled nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts the traveler's reverent posture with the stubborn man's mired cart, suggesting the blessing of continual reverence and the calamity associated with a hardened heart.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed ruler points from a stone throne toward worried villagers, one holding an empty basket, while the shadows of a roaring lion and a bear loom on the wall behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: In this imaginative interpretation, the lion and bear shadows picture the threat a wicked ruler poses to poor people; no one is harmed.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient courtyard, a seated ruler looks away while an official takes a basket of grain from a worried farmer beside his family; beneath an old olive tree, a seated elder raises his hand to refuse a man offering a pouch of coins.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts an oppressive ruler lacking understanding with an elder who refuses covetous gain. The old olive tree suggests the prolonged days associated with rejecting covetousness.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A solitary man carries a heavy red cloth bundle of stones along a sunlit path toward a fenced, stone-lined pit. An unlit clay lamp rests on a rock in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the burden of bloodshed with a load of stones and a life lost with an extinguished lamp. The traveler's isolation and the guarded pit evoke the verse's warning about flight and the absence of help without depicting harm.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler carrying a bag and staff walks on a sunlit, stone-lined road beside a village gate, while a tipped clay jar spills water near a winding, rocky path across the hillside.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative interpretation of Proverbs 28:18: the firm path and village suggest the safety of walking blamelessly; the tipped jar beside the crooked path suggests the sudden fall warned of for those perverse in their ways.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A farmer hoes rows of green plants beside a basket full of round loaves, while another person runs through a dry field after colorful ribbons near an empty basket; a village and hills lie beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the verse's contrast: the person who tills his land has bread, while the pursuit of frivolity is represented by someone chasing ribbons near an empty basket.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A frightened man runs along a sunlit stone road, looking back toward a man and woman standing calmly with a lion beside a village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative interpretation of Proverbs 28:1: a frightened figure runs though no one pursues, while the still lion beside the calm villagers pictures the boldness of the righteous.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A grain seller pours grain into a sack for a smiling mother and child amid full baskets, while another man clutches a bag of coins and an elder gestures toward scales and weights in a sunlit village market.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative marketplace scene uses the plentiful harvest and grateful neighbors to picture the blessings of faithfulness, while the elder's challenge to the coin-clutching merchant suggests accountability for the hurried pursuit of riches.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone town gate, a man offers a small piece of bread to a seated elder who presses down one pan of a balance, while another man in worn clothes waits to the side.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the warning that showing partiality is wrong and that a person can transgress for even a piece of bread; the tilted balance suggests an unfair judgment.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village market, a robed man reaches eagerly toward a merchant's stacked gold coins while grain spills from a torn sack on his shoulder onto the ground beside a shallow bowl.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the man's rush toward riches while the grain escaping unnoticed suggests the poverty he does not foresee.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a market table, a smiling merchant touches the shoulder of a man who gestures beside a brass balance; a richly dressed man smiles and gestures at the merchant nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative market scene pictures a merchant appreciating a friend's candid correction while another man flatters him, echoing the proverb's contrast between rebuke and flattery and the favor found afterward.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man and woman look on anxiously beside an open chest as a younger man shrugs and holds a tied pouch; another man tips a wooden barrel, spilling grain onto the courtyard stones.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts a son dismissing his theft from his parents; his companion spilling grain symbolizes the destroyer in Proverbs 28:24.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A stern man in red points and argues with worried neighbors in a sunlit village courtyard, while another man lifts open hands beside baskets of grain and fruit and a golden field.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts a proud man's strife with a prayerful person's trust in Yahweh; the abundant harvest represents being prospered.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man with one hand on his chest stands beside a path blocked by thorny branches and rocks, while another traveler crosses a stone bridge toward a sunlit walled village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts trusting one's own heart with walking wisely: the blocked path and safe crossing suggest folly and deliverance in Proverbs 28:26.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village street, a woman with a basket of food offers bread to a seated man in worn clothing. Nearby, a richly dressed man closes his eyes and raises a hand toward another seated person beneath a dark cloud.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts giving to a person in need with closing one's eyes to another. The food remaining in the basket suggests the giver does not lack, while the cloud hints at the warning of many curses.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man peers from a shadowed doorway while neighbors and children gather in a sunlit stone town square. Above them, an empty overturned seat rests beneath a dark shadow breaking apart into the sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 28:28: the sheltered man recalls people hiding when the wicked rise, while the fallen seat and fading shadow suggest their passing and the gathering neighbors suggest the righteous increasing.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in plain robes points toward an olive grove while villagers place stones along a flowing water channel. Four richly dressed men gesture at one another near a hillside village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses disagreement among princes and the repair of a water channel to suggest the proverb's contrast between a land's transgression and many rulers, and the enduring right associated with understanding and knowledge.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holds a tied sack while a seated man reaches toward him from a stone doorway. A woman and child look on beside an empty bowl, and driving rain falls over a muddy field of flattened grain.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures a poor man taking a family's food, echoing the verse's comparison between oppressing the poor and driving rain that leaves no food.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village market, two men applaud a smiling trader holding a coin over a tilted balance; opposite them, a man gestures toward the trader as a woman holds a blank scroll.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative marketplace scene depicts people praising a dishonest trader while those represented as keeping the law peacefully contend with him, reflecting the contrast in Proverbs 28:4.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone city gate, two richly dressed men clutch purses and turn away while an older woman at a table faces a bowed man who reaches toward her beside a pair of balanced scales.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined city-gate encounter uses the men's refusal, a bowed seeker and balanced scales to illustrate Proverbs 28:5's contrast between those who do not understand justice and those who seek the Lord.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village market, a traveler in worn clothes offers a small purse to an older man, while a richly dressed merchant presses a finger on a balance scale at his stall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts a poor traveler's honest return of a purse with a wealthy merchant manipulating a scale, illustrating the verse's preference for integrity over crooked wealth.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunny stone courtyard, an older man has his arm around a young man holding a rolled scroll while he looks toward three men eating at a table piled with food; scraps lie on the ground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene contrasts a discerning son who keeps the law, suggested by the closed scroll, with a son who joins gluttonous companions and brings shame to his father.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a worried man stands beside a richly dressed man counting a pile of coins. Coins roll down a sloping table toward a second man who offers them to a seated woman and child.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a sloping table and rolling coins to represent wealth gained by usury and extortion reaching someone who shows compassion to the poor, as described in Proverbs 28:8.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A kneeling man raises one hand in prayer while covering his ear and turning away from an older man offering a blank scroll in a sunlit stone courtyard. Incense smoke curls toward the shadow of a doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays someone refusing to hear the law while praying. The smoke drifting into shadow suggests the verse's warning that such a prayer is an abomination.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village, a woman offers a cup to a traveler while an older man welcomes him toward a doorway; two men glare at the traveler from a short distance away.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 29:10 by showing hostile men looking on as upright neighbors seek the blameless traveler's well-being.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a seated man gestures with both arms and speaks with his mouth open while another seated man listens with one hand on his chest. A clay jar and an olive tree stand nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the proverb's contrast between venting feelings and wisely holding them back until later.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit palace, a crowned ruler listens to a whispering courtier while three attendants gather around a coin beside a balance scale weighted with silver.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows a ruler listening to a false report while attendants exchange a coin, suggesting the warning in Proverbs 29:12 that when a ruler pays attention to lies, his servants become wicked.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in a patched robe holds a nearly empty basket and looks up at a stern, richly dressed man holding a purse in a sunlit stone courtyard, with olive branches and a distant village behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses two men of unequal means and shared sunlight to picture Proverbs 29:13: the poor man and the oppressor both receive light for their eyes from the Lord.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king on a stone throne listens as a kneeling man in patched clothing gestures toward him. Scales stand between them, while other people wait in a sunlit courtyard with hills beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative court hearing illustrates a king judging the poor with truth; the throne's firm stone foundation suggests its lasting establishment.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman gestures to a boy gathering figs from a toppled basket. A man watches from a wall, and a wooden rod rests against the stonework.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a spilled basket and a mother's correction to suggest the verse's warning that a child left to himself can bring his mother shame; the unused rod symbolizes the discipline associated with wisdom.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone marketplace, three men handle a balance, coins, and a sack of grain while two townspeople stand nearby. An ornate empty chair lies overturned beside scattered coins.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects multiplying wrongdoing with the righteous witnessing the wicked's downfall; the empty overturned chair symbolizes the loss of power.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father sits on a stone bench beneath an olive tree and points toward fallen figs as his son kneels to gather them; both smile in a sunlit village courtyard.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a father patiently guiding his son as he gathers spilled figs, suggesting the rest and delight that the verse associates with correcting a son.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient village market, a woman and an older man smile as they gather spilled fruit into a basket. Townspeople walk in different directions near an open stone gateway, while an unlit oil lamp and a rolled scroll rest in the foreground.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses an unlit lamp and townspeople moving in different directions to suggest the absence of revelation and the people casting off restraint. The smiling helper and closed scroll suggest the happiness of keeping the law; the events are imagined.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a standing man gestures toward a large clay jar beside a well while a seated man looks up at him with his hands in his lap.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative household scene reflects the proverb's warning that words alone may not correct a servant who understands but does not respond; the untouched jar suggests an instruction has not prompted action.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older bearded man gestures toward a man who turns away with folded arms. A clay water jar lies shattered among spilled water at their feet.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows an unyielding man turning away from counsel. The shattered jar suggests the verse's warning that someone who repeatedly resists correction can suddenly be broken beyond remedy; no person is harmed.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a man gestures and speaks to a seated elder who raises one hand, while another man beside a tipped basket of figs looks toward them. A small green plant grows by the scattered fruit.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts a man speaking over an elder with a clumsy man pausing to listen; the young plant suggests hope. Proverbs 29:20 says there is more hope for a fool than for someone hasty in words.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit courtyard, an older man embraces a younger man and adjusts a blue mantle around his shoulders. A tray of fruit and a cup sit on a low table, while small sandals and a wooden toy cart rest beneath a bench.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures a servant pampered from childhood and later treated as a son. The small sandals and toy suggest the years since childhood, and the mantle and affectionate gesture suggest the master's favor.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village marketplace, an angry man sweeps goods from a stall as fruit, baskets and broken clay vessels scatter. Nearby townspeople gesture and argue while a concerned onlooker watches.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined marketplace quarrel pictures anger stirring up strife, with the scattered goods suggesting the wrongdoing that can accompany fury.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a richly dressed man sits looking down beside a jeweled crown, while a man carrying a clay water jar receives a leafy wreath from an older villager.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the crown set low and the wreath offered to a helpful man to suggest the verse's contrast: pride brings a person low, while the humble in spirit retain honor.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, a gray-bearded elder raises one hand while two seated men each hold a small pouch. One man looks sideways toward his companion, who bows his head with a hand near his mouth. An open chest of coins, bundled goods and coils of rope lie in the foreground as villagers look on.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative village hearing portrays a thief's partner staying silent as an oath is called. The shared pouches and loose rope around the goods suggest a partnership that entangles him and endangers his own life without depicting injury.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler clasps his hands and looks anxiously back at a small group of people. An empty rope loop lies on the rocky path in the foreground, and a stone refuge stands on a sunlit hill.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses an empty rope loop and a high refuge to picture the verse's contrast between fear of people as a snare and safety in trusting Yahweh.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone court, several people appeal to a seated, crowned ruler while a man in the foreground looks upward beside a two-pan scale on a stone stand.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts people seeking a ruler's favor with a person beside sunlit scales, suggesting that justice comes from Yahweh.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village market, a trader presses a hand into a pan of grain on a balance scale and scowls toward a man holding up an open palm. Another man stands behind him with folded arms.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined marketplace confrontation illustrates the verse's mutual aversion: the upright person objects to the trader's injustice, and the trader looks back at him with contempt.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a stone city square, smiling townspeople gather around seated elders with baskets of grain and bread. Beneath a shaded colonnade, a stern crowned ruler clutches a basket of grain while weary people bow their heads nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative comparison pictures people rejoicing under righteous leaders and groaning under a wicked ruler, using shared food and hoarded grain to express the contrast.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling older man puts an arm around a younger man as they point to an open scroll. Nearby, another man lets coins fall from a purse while seated with two women.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts a son's study with his delighted father and a man spending coins in company, recalling the verse's warning that a companion of prostitutes wastes wealth.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king listens to two townspeople beside balanced scales at a city gate, while one man takes a pouch from another beside a crumbling stone wall. Cultivated hills and a city lie beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses sound and crumbling masonry to picture the verse's contrast between justice establishing the land and bribery undermining it.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village, a smiling man crouches, gesturing toward a standing man while holding a rope net spread on the ground before the standing man's sandaled feet.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts flattery as a net spread before a neighbor's feet, a safe visual metaphor for the proverb's warning.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient village market, a startled man clutching dates reaches into a basket while rope tangles around his sandals. Nearby, a smiling man sits on a low stone wall, singing and playing a lyre.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a would-be thief's tangled rope to suggest the snare of transgression, while the joyful singer pictures the righteous singing and rejoicing.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone town gate, a woman in patched clothes gestures as she speaks to a man listening thoughtfully across a stone table with a balance scale. Beside them, a richly dressed man turns away and looks into a pouch of coins.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative town-gate hearing shows one person attending to a poor woman's cause while another turns away, suggesting the contrast in Proverbs 29:7 between the righteous person's concern and the wicked person's lack of understanding.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone city square, two laughing men stand beside a flaming brazier while two robed men address a crowd with open hands.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a contained flame to picture scoffers stirring up a city, while calm mediators suggest wise people turning away wrath.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men in robes sit across a low stone table in a sunlit courtyard. One gestures with open hands while the other leans back laughing and raises a hand. An olive branch lies on the table between them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined exchange shows a wise man trying to reason with a fool who laughs dismissively; the untouched olive branch suggests the lack of peace in their dispute.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A sunlit stone granary piled high with golden grain stands beside stone vats overflowing with dark red wine, surrounded by grapevines and baskets of grapes.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative harvest scene illustrating Proverbs 3:10's barns filled with plenty and vats overflowing with new wine.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father points as a boy steadies a young tree tied to a wooden support in a sunlit garden, with stone terraces, olive trees, hills, and a distant village.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a father guiding his son, echoing Proverbs 3:11's call not to despise Yahweh's discipline or detest his correction.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father rests a hand on his son's shoulder as they kneel together and plant a young tree in a sunlit olive grove, with a stone village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined father guiding his son evokes the verse's comparison between the Lord's loving correction and a father's delight in his son.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling man crouches beneath an olive tree, holding a lit clay lamp beside a rocky path. Olive groves, hills, and a village stretch into the sunset.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative image of the joy of finding wisdom and gaining understanding in Proverbs 3:13; the lamp and path are visual metaphors.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: An older teacher gestures toward a fruit-laden fig tree while a young learner listens in a sunlit village courtyard; an open chest of silver coins and gold sits nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting that wisdom's gain is better than the profit of silver and fine gold in Proverbs 3:14.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young person listens to an older woman who gestures beneath an olive tree. An open chest of red gems and gold jewelry rests nearby, with a village and hills in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of wisdom as a woman offering counsel, with rubies set aside, reflecting Proverbs 3:15's comparison of wisdom with precious things.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a sunlit landscape holds a leafy olive branch in her right hand and a shallow dish of gold coins and a golden circlet in her left. A younger traveler and an elder walk together along a winding path among olive trees and distant stone houses.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative portrayal of Wisdom uses the olive branch and long path to suggest length of days in her right hand, and the coins and circlet to suggest riches and honor in her left, as in Proverbs 3:16.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a green head covering holds a child's hand and gestures toward winding paths through an olive grove and wildflowers, with a village and mountains beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene personifies wisdom as a woman guiding a child along pleasant paths, reflecting Proverbs 3:17's picture of her ways as pleasant and her paths as peace.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warm watercolor scene, two adults and two children smile while holding the trunk and low branches of a large fig tree, with wildflowers, rolling hills and a small village beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of Proverbs 3:18: wisdom is a tree of life to those who take hold of her, and those who retain her are happy.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor landscape with exposed layers of bedrock beneath green hills and trees, snowcapped mountains, and a blue sea, under a glowing cloud-filled sky that deepens into stars.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a firm earth beneath an ordered sky, reflecting Proverbs 3:19's description of Yahweh founding the earth by wisdom and establishing the heavens by understanding.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A father gestures as he teaches his son beneath an olive tree in a sunlit stone courtyard. The boy sits on a woven mat, looking up at him with one hand over his heart. Clay vessels, a bowl of olives, village buildings, and distant hills surround them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a father teaching his son, suggesting Proverbs 3:1's call to remember the teaching and keep its commands in the heart.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A foaming spring pours from a cleft in a rocky hillside into a stream, while droplets hang beneath dawn clouds and bead on leaves; sunlit hills stretch into the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 3:20: water emerging from split rock suggests the depths broken open by God's knowledge, while the clouds and droplets evoke dew.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: On a rocky hillside path at sunset, a man holding a staff points toward a distant village while a boy holds a lit clay lamp and looks up at him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative father-and-son scene uses the lamp as a reminder of Proverbs 3:21: keep sound wisdom and discretion in sight.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling woman in a white robe and head covering holds a leafy sapling in soil and wears a gold leaf necklace beside flowing water in a sunlit garden.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 3:22: the sapling and spring suggest life for the soul, while the necklace evokes grace for the neck.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A sandaled traveler walks along a sunlit path bordered by stones and wildflowers, with trees, a village, and mountains in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene echoes Proverbs 3:23 by showing a traveler walking safely without stumbling.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man sleeps on his side under a red and cream woven blanket in a stone room. An oil lamp glows on a shelf, and olive trees and a distant village are visible through an open window beneath a starry sky.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of peaceful sleep illustrates Proverbs 3:24's promise of lying down without fear and sleeping sweetly.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed traveler with a staff and satchel stands on a rocky path, calmly looking toward a vast dust cloud over a distant stone settlement where small figures move.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a traveler facing an approaching disturbance, reflecting Proverbs 3:25's call not to fear sudden terror or trouble associated with the wicked when it comes.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A sandaled traveler carrying a pack and staff steps onto a rock beyond a loose rope snare, looking toward the sun above a hillside village and distant mountains.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 3:26: Yahweh is the reader's confidence and keeps their foot from being caught.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A standing man hands a leather pouch to a kneeling worker beside a hoe in a sunlit stone courtyard, with an olive tree and baskets of grapes and grain.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined payment of wages illustrates Proverbs 3:27's instruction to give good to those to whom it is due when it is within one's power.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village, a neighbor holds out empty hands toward a man in a doorway. The man raises one hand and points away with the other, while a basket of bread sits within reach beside him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 3:28's warning against asking a neighbor to return tomorrow when the means to help are already at hand.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village, a man relaxes with a cup beside his doorway while another crouches behind a low wall, holding a cord attached to a loop on the shared path.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 3:29: the peaceful neighbor's trust contrasts with the concealed snare, illustrating the warning against devising harm toward a neighbor who dwells securely beside you.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A white-haired man with a walking staff holds a smiling child's hand as they walk along a sunlit path through olive trees. A stone house, hills, and a low sun appear in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of generations on a peaceful path, reflecting Proverbs 3:2's length of days, years of life, and peace.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures with an open hand toward a calm neighbor holding a clay water jar beside a stone well, with sunlit buildings, trees, and fields behind them.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative moment of restraint evokes the proverb's counsel not to quarrel without cause with someone who has done no harm.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village marketplace, a richly dressed man holding a basket of fruit offers coins to a kneeling young traveler, who raises a hand while gathering spilled produce near an anxious seated seller.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Proverbs 3:31's warning not to envy an oppressor or choose his ways: the traveler refuses his offer and helps the seller.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Five people gather beneath a fig tree in a sunlit stone courtyard; a man gestures as the others listen, while a merchant holds a weight beside a balance at a nearby stall.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests God's secret counsel with the upright through a quiet gathering, contrasted with a merchant who hints at crooked conduct, echoing Proverbs 3:32.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a watercolor village, rain falls from a dark cloud over a closed, weathered house and dry plants. Across a path, four people share bread outside a sunlit home surrounded by green vines and grapes.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Proverbs 3:33's contrast between Yahweh's curse on the house of the wicked and His blessing on the home of the just.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man helps a kneeling woman in worn clothes in a sunny stone courtyard, while two ornately dressed men recoil from a gust of wind.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 3:34: the gust suggests God's scorn toward the scornful, while the helping hand and sunlight suggest grace given to the afflicted or humble.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an elder holds a leafy wreath above a seated man's head while a woman beside him holds olive branches. Nearby, two men look dismayed beside an overturned water jar and a fallen wreath.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of Proverbs 3:35's contrast between the wise inheriting glory and fools receiving shame.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a kneeling young person offers a bowl of water to an older seated traveler. A red-and-gold braided necklace holds a blank heart-shaped pendant at the person's chest; a donkey and clay jars are nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of Proverbs 3:3: the intertwined cords and heart-shaped pendant evoke binding mercy and truth close and writing them on the heart, while the offered water pictures mercy.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man kneels at a sunlit stone village gate, offering a cup to a seated elder holding a walking staff as smiling villagers look on; olive branches and a hillside village fill the background.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of kindness and community esteem reflects Proverbs 3:4's finding favor and high esteem in the sight of God and people.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated traveler rests one hand over his heart and looks toward sunlight breaking through clouds. A parchment lies on a rock beside him, with olive trees, a winding path, distant hills, and a village around him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests trusting Yahweh with one's whole heart instead of leaning on one's own understanding; the set-aside parchment is a visual metaphor.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed traveler kneels with hands clasped beside a sunlit path under an olive tree. The path runs between stone walls toward villages, trees, and mountains in a golden valley.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a traveler praying as a path opens ahead, evoking Proverbs 3:6's call to acknowledge God and His direction of one's paths.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded traveler kneels at a fork in a rocky hillside, head bowed and one hand against his chest, as he touches a small bronze mirror on a stone. A dark, thorn-choked path lies behind him, while a sunlit path winds past olive trees toward distant houses and hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative visual metaphor for Proverbs 3:7: the traveler sets aside self-regard, bows in reverence to the LORD, and turns away from the thorny path.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling man in a cream tunic stands with one hand on his abdomen and the other touching an olive tree with exposed roots beside a clear stream; a sunlit village and hills lie beyond.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the verse's health for the flesh and strength for the bones through the man's steady posture and the well-watered, rooted tree.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A kneeling farmer places a woven basket of figs and grapes beside a sheaf of grain on a low stone platform, with a fig tree, grapevines, a golden field, and a distant village behind him.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of honoring God with one's possessions and the firstfruits of one's increase, inspired by Proverbs 3:9.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man whispers and points beside a seated man, while a third man beside a clay jar looks toward them with one hand raised.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined encounter shows a servant overhearing someone speak against him to his master and protesting. It illustrates the warning that maligning a servant may bring his curse and leave the speaker guilty.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a younger man gestures angrily toward a seated older man while an older woman reaches toward him from behind.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the verse's warning about a generation that curses its father and does not bless its mother.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Four contented people in mud-stained clothing stand or sit in a sunny stone courtyard. A seated man holds a small bronze mirror beside a basin of water and a folded cloth.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Proverbs 30:12 through people who admire themselves despite their grime while a washbasin sits unused, picturing those who see themselves as pure but remain unwashed from their filth.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Four richly dressed townspeople of different ages stand on stone steps with their chins raised, while two plainly dressed neighbors pass below in a sunlit village with olive trees and distant hills.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the generation's lofty eyes and lifted eyelids as expressions of pride.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A poor family sits beside a nearly empty basket in a village market as three richly dressed men carry sacks of grain away. On the ground, a large shadow resembles an open mouth lined with sword- and knife-shaped teeth.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative marketplace scene portrays the verse's warning about a generation that devours the poor and needy: the blade-toothed shadow suggests the swords and knives in the verse, while the grain being carried away suggests exploitation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A large brown leech and two smaller leeches look up toward a hand offering figs beside a pond. Three bowls of figs sit to the left and a fourth to the right, with trees, hills, and a village in the distance.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows the leech and her two daughters reaching for more despite having plenty. Four bowls grouped as three and one suggest the verse's three-and-four saying about things that are never satisfied; the figs and bowls are artistic additions.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman pours water from a clay jug onto cracked earth beside an empty woven cradle. A dark rock-cut tomb is in the hillside behind her, and a wood fire burns in a stone hearth nearby.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene brings together the grave, the barren womb, thirsty earth, and the fire that never says enough in Proverbs 30:16. The empty cradle suggests longing for a child; the woman and landscape are an artistic interpretation.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man with folded arms looks back at his concerned parents in a rocky valley. Beside a stream, two ravens stand by a wooden disk marked with an eye, while two eagles sit in a nest above.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative interpretation of the warning against mocking a father and scorning obedience to a mother uses ravens, nesting eagles, and a wooden eye emblem to suggest the consequence without depicting injury.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A contemplative bearded man in a robe sits beneath a tree on a golden hillside, looking toward the sunlit clouds above a lake and distant mountains.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the speaker's wonder at things beyond his understanding; the verse itself does not identify them.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A man and a young woman sit talking on a rocky shore, while a serpent crosses a foreground rock, an eagle soars overhead, and a wooden sailing ship travels across the sea.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: In this imaginative scene, the conversation suggests the verse's way of a man with a virgin; the eagle, serpent on rock, and ship at sea evoke its other three ways.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a bearded man in a cream robe gestures as two men in blue and red listen. Trees, clay jars, distant buildings and hills frame the scene.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene shows Agur, son of Jakeh, addressing listeners representing Ithiel and Ucal. Proverbs 30:1 introduces his utterance; the setting and appearances are artistic interpretations.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman at a table with bread, grapes, and figs wipes her mouth with a cloth and raises one hand, while a clothed man leaves through a curtained doorway.
records_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the proverb's adulterous woman eating, wiping her mouth, and denying wrongdoing; the departing man suggests a secret relationship.

records_chirho.alt_chirho: Three large stones rest on a cracked earthen mound, with a fourth stone balanced above them, in a sunlit golden landscape.
